caption: The drawing depicts a metallic mug with a cylindrical body and a large, rounded handle attached to the right side. The mug features horizontal bands near the top and bottom, with the body of the mug shaded in gray tones to indicate its metallic surface and reflective quality. The handle is textured with a twisted or braided appearance and extends outward in a looping curve. The image is bordered by a brownish, uneven rectangular wash that frames the mug. Above the mug, the word "MUG" is written in uppercase letters, and in the upper left corner, the text "CASE No 2" appears. In the lower right corner, there is additional text that reads "No. 18/799—18, 5. Inches High, Alfred Nason." The overall composition centers the mug and uses neutral tones of gray and brown.
title: Silver Mug
